[EN] (Guild) Order to Subjugate the Change Forest
[ES] (Gremio) Orden para subyugar el Change Forest
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Continuous subjugation always brings peace.
[ES] La subyugación continua siempre trae la paz.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Thank you for your hard work.
[ES] Gracias por tu arduo trabajo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Token of Subjugating the Change Forest
[ES] Ficha de subyugación del Change Forest
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "It's an honor to serve."
[ES] "Es un honor servir."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill {@Creature:47#2001#argonomorph caprin imps}, {@Creature:47#2002#argonomorph faeries}, and {@Creature:47#2003#argonomorph gulas} around the {@Rgn:47003$$Bridgehead} and collect tokens.
[ES] Mata a {@Creature:47#2001#argonomorph caprin imps}, {@Creature:47#2002#argonomorph faeries} y {@Creature:47#2003#argonomorph gulas} alrededor del {@Rgn:47003$$Bridgehead} y recoge fichas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Laetesha at Pathfinder Post when mission is complete.
[ES] Informa a Laetesha en Pathfinder Post cuando la misión esté completa.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
